y-m-61-10.topic: Daangaa hojii: daangaa firaakshinii qoodaan 0 bira dhiyaatu, fi koofishiyentii murtaa'uu hin dandeenye

y-m-61-10.s.s2.hint.1: Qoodaan gama negatiivii irraa gara 0 tti yeroo dhiyaatu illee mirkaneeffadhu.

y-m-61-10.s.s3.prompt: Dura gatii daangaa L murteessi, achiis lakkoofsa guutuu a fi b gatii daangaa sana kennan argi. Sadii (a, b, L), L adda addaa qaban, daangaan (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) x gara 1 tti yeroo dhiyaatu L (lakkoofsa guutuu 1≤L≤5) akka ta'u galchi.

y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Lakkoofsi gubbaa x=1 irratti 0 miti. Gatiin murtaa'e akka ba'uuf lakkoofsi gubbaa 0 ta'uu qaba.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c3: Gatiin daangaa erga haqamee booda, a+2, L waliin wal-qixa dha.
